file paths /var/tmp/ in commented SELECT clauses

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical clinic/hospital receipt (shinryo-koui) input processing subsystem for the JMA ORCA standard medical billing software
purpose.summary: ORCGK02 is a large batch/interactive subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that handles medical procedure (shinryo-koui) input and editing. It manages patient visit records, insurance combinations, prescription sets, and various medical billing calculations for Japanese national health insurance claims.

notable_features: 73 COPY statements referencing domain-specific copybooks (CPK02SPASCR.INC, COMMON-SPA, K02SCR-SPA, ENUM-VALUE, etc.)
121 CALL statements indicating heavy subprogram delegation
810 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
No COMP-3 usage (PIC 9 fields without COMP-3)
Linux file system paths in commented-out SELECT clauses
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (displayed as latin-1 mojibake in the excerpt). The file is 15605 lines and highly mature production code with an 18-year revision history. Truncated at 16000 chars; full file is ~656KB. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project.
